subtitle: Okungalingani kwezinombolo
short_description: Gcwalisa igridi ye-4×4 ngo-1 kuya ku-4 ulandele izimpawu zokungalingani.
description:
Gcwalisa igridi ye-4×4 ngezinombolo ezingu-1 kuya ku-4 ukuze inombolo ngayinye ivele kanye emugqeni ngamunye nakukholomu ngayinye, bese izimpawu zokuthi ngaphezu kwe noma ngaphansi kwe phakathi kwamaseli aseduze ziqinisekiswe.

Thepha iseli elivulekile bese uthepha enye yezinkinobho ezine ezinkulu zamadijithi. Sula noLandelayo kuhlala kubonakala.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
